tips.title: Define boundary type
tips.body: Select the type of boundary (e.g., box, silhouette) for tool relation.

tips.title: Create manually created boundaries in 3D
tips.body: Manually create boundary boxes, silhouettes, user-defined, or combined.

tips.title: Set pass parameters for milling operations

tips.title: Adjust step over for milling operations

tips.title: Enable climb milling for better surface finish

tips.title: Detect flat areas during milling operations
tips.body: Automatically detect and handle flat areas to avoid tool damage.

tips.title: Set limits for milling operations
tips.body: Define upper and lower limits for tool movement.

tips.title: Reduce points for efficient milling

tips.title: Refine corners for better surface finish
tips.body: Smooth out sharp corners to achieve a smoother surface.

tips.title: Smooth toolpaths for better surface finish
tips.body: Use smoothing to reduce toolpath irregularities.

tips.title: Set maximum ramp angle for toolpath optimization
tips.body: Limit the maximum ramp angle to avoid excessive acceleration.

tips.title: Detect core areas for efficient milling
tips.body: Automatically detect and handle core areas to improve efficiency.

tips.title: Set scallop size for finish milling
tips.body: Define the size of scallops to achieve a smooth surface.

tips.title: Enable tangential extension for finish milling
tips.body: Use tangential extension to improve surface finish.

tips.title: Define angle by direction for toolpath orientation
tips.body: Set the angle of toolpaths based on direction.

tips.title: Set clockwise or counterclockwise direction for toolpath orientation
tips.body: Specify the direction of toolpaths (clockwise, counterclockwise).

tips.title: Set right/left clear offset for toolpath clearance
tips.body: Define the distance between toolpaths and stock (right, left).

tips.title: Set bit engagement angle
tips.body: Configure the bit engagement angle for optimal tool performance.

tips.title: Define steep threshold angle
tips.body: Set the steep threshold angle to control tool path behavior in steep areas.

tips.title: Extend steep areas
tips.body: Enable the option to extend steep areas for better tool engagement.

tips.title: Configure shallow areas strategy
tips.body: Select the appropriate strategy for handling shallow areas in toolpaths.

tips.title: Set depth of cut
tips.body: Define the depth of cut for each pass to control material removal rate.

tips.title: Define areas for toolpath generation
tips.body: Specify the areas where toolpaths should be generated.

tips.title: Order toolpath strokes
tips.body: Arrange the order of toolpath strokes for efficient machining.

tips.title: Set reference tool for operations
tips.body: Select the reference tool for all machining operations.

tips.title: Configure variable stepover
tips.body: Enable the option to use a variable stepover for better tool engagement.

tips.title: Set horizontal/vertical stepover
tips.body: Configure the stepover for both horizontal and vertical directions.

tips.title: Limit number of offset layers
tips.body: Set a maximum limit on the number of offset layers for toolpath generation.

tips.title: Enable adaptive variable side step
tips.body: Activate the adaptive variable side step for better tool engagement.

tips.title: Handle overthickness
tips.body: Configure how to handle overthickness during toolpath generation.

tips.title: Set offset type
tips.body: Select the type of offset to be used in toolpath generation.

tips.title: Configure passes parameters for combined strategies
tips.body: Set the parameters for passes when using combined machining strategies.

tips.title: Set maximum radius for smoothing
tips.body: Define the maximum radius for toolpath smoothing.

tips.title: Set profile tolerance for smoothing
tips.body: Configure the profile tolerance for toolpath smoothing.

tips.title: Set offset tolerance for smoothing
tips.body: Define the offset tolerance for toolpath smoothing.

tips.title: Configure adaptive step down parameters
tips.body: Set the parameters for adaptive step down during toolpath generation.

tips.title: Edit passes parameters for combined strategies
tips.body: Modify the parameters for passes when using combined machining strategies.

tips.title: Set axial offset for toolpaths
tips.body: Configure the axial offset for toolpath generation.

tips.title: Configure cross parameters for toolpaths
tips.body: Set the parameters for cross operations in toolpath generation.

tips.title: Set general parameters for links
tips.body: Configure the general parameters for link operations.

tips.title: Set direction options for links
tips.body: Select the direction options for link operations.

tips.title: Order passes for links
tips.body: Arrange the order of passes for link operations.

tips.title: Configure retract style for links
tips.body: Set the style of retraction for link operations.

tips.title: Set start hint for links
tips.body: Configure the start hint for link operations.

tips.title: Link by Z-level for operations
tips.body: Enable the option to link operations by Z-level.

tips.title: Link per cluster for operations
tips.body: Enable the option to link operations per cluster.

tips.title: Use dynamic stock for operations
tips.body: Activate the option to use dynamic stock during link operations.

tips.title: Set minimum profile for operations
tips.body: Configure the minimum profile for link operations.

tips.title: Enable refurbishment for operations
tips.body: Activate the option to enable refurbishment during link operations.

tips.title: Configure safety parameters for links
tips.body: Set the safety parameters for link operations.

tips.title: Set general parameters for ramping
tips.body: Configure the general parameters for ramping operations.

tips.title: Set general parameters for strategy
tips.body: Configure the general parameters for machining strategies.

tips.title: Stay on surface within for strategy
tips.body: Configure the stay on surface within parameter for machining strategies.

tips.title: Stay down within for strategy
tips.body: Configure the stay down within parameter for machining strategies.

tips.title: Overlap closed passes for strategy
tips.body: Enable the option to overlap closed passes during machining strategies.

tips.title: Along surface for strategy
tips.body: Configure the along surface parameter for machining strategies.

tips.title: Set linking radius for strategy
tips.body: Configure the linking radius parameter for machining strategies.

tips.title: Set link clearance for strategy
tips.body: Configure the link clearance parameter for machining strategies.

tips.title: Set general parameters for retractions
tips.body: Configure the general parameters for retraction operations.

tips.title: Set retraction style for retractions
tips.body: Configure the style of retraction for retractions.

tips.title: Use default values for parameters
tips.body: Most parameters in InventorCAM HSM operations receive default values based on built-in formulas that define dependencies between parameters.

tips.title: Reset parameters to default values
tips.body: You can reset a parameter, all parameters on the current page, or all parameters of the current HSM operation to their default formulas and values using the Reset commands.

tips.title: Choose machining strategies for HSM operations
tips.body: The Technology section enables you to choose a finishing or roughing machining strategy to be applied, with options such as Constant Z machining, Hybrid Constant Z, Helical machining, and more.

tips.title: Constant Z Machining
tips.body: Generates sections at different Z-heights based on Step down parameter, suitable for semi-finishing and finishing steep model areas with inclination angles between 30 and 90 degrees.

tips.title: Hybrid Constant Z
tips.body: Combines benefits of traditional Constant Z with 3D pocketing, optimizing finish over the entire part by inserting additional passes in shallow areas.

tips.title: Helical Machining
tips.body: Generates closed profile sections at different Z-levels and joins them in a continuous descending ramp for helical machining.

tips.title: Horizontal Machining
tips.body: Generates pocket-style tool paths for machining flat areas, with the distance between passes determined by Offset parameters.

tips.title: Linear Machining
tips.body: Generates parallel passes at a set angle with the distance between passes defined by Step over parameter.

tips.title: Radial Machining
tips.body: Generates radial passes rotated around a central point, effective for shallow curved surfaces and revolution bodies.

tips.title: Spiral Machining
tips.body: Generates a 3D spiral tool path over the model, optimal for revolution bodies.

tips.title: Morphed Machining
tips.body: Generates passes in a close-to-parallel formation, each path repeating the shape of the previous one and taking on characteristics of the next.

tips.title: Offset Cutting
tips.body: A particular case of Morphed machining, generates a tool path using a single Drive curve and an offset curve.

tips.title: Boundary Machining
tips.body: Creates tool paths by projecting the defined Drive boundary on the model geometry, suitable for engraving and chamfer machining.

tips.title: Rest Machining
tips.body: Determines model areas where material remains after machining and generates passes to machine these areas, particularly useful for vertical corners.

tips.title: Contour Rest Machining
tips.body: Uses any combination of tools to remove rest material, calculating flat areas and generating contour passes similar to Contour roughing.

tips.title: 3D Constant Step Over Machining
tips.body: Generates a 3D tool path with passes located at a constant distance from each other, measured along the surface of the model.

tips.title: Pencil Milling
tips.body: Creates tool paths along internal corners and fillets with small radii, useful for finishing corners where the fillet radius is equal to or smaller than the tool radius.

tips.title: Parallel Pencil Milling
tips.body: Combines Pencil milling with 3D Constant step over, generating passes as offsets on both sides of the pencil milling passes.

tips.title: 3D Corner Offset
tips.body: Similar to Parallel pencil milling, generates passes as offsets from the Pencil milling passes, automatically determining the number of offsets.

tips.title: Prismatic Part Machining
tips.body: Designed for high-speed finishing of prismatic parts, combining Constant Z and 3D Constant step over strategies.

tips.title: Combined Strategies
tips.body: Allows combining two machining strategies in a single HSM operation, sharing Geometry, Tool and Constraint boundaries data.

tips.title: Customize Menu
tips.body: Enables simplifying the user interface by selecting required technologies for machining, displaying only selected options in the Technology list.

tips.title: Geometry Definition
tips.body: Defines the 3D model geometry for HSM operations, including specifying Coordinate System and machining geometry.

tips.title: CoordSys Definition
tips.body: Enables defining the Coordinate System for operations by choosing from a combo-box or selecting on the graphic screen.

tips.title: Define target geometry
tips.body: Select or create a 3D model geometry for the HSM operation in Autodesk Inventor.

tips.title: Set facet tolerance for triangulation
tips.body: Adjust the facet tolerance to balance accuracy and calculation speed.

tips.title: Enable micro milling for small parts
tips.body: Check the Micro Milling box to tighten facet tolerance for extremely small parts.

tips.title: Apply fillets to internal corners
tips.body: Check the Apply Fillets box to automatically add fillets for smoother tool movement.

tips.title: Define boundary type for fillets
tips.body: Choose from Auto-created silhouette, Outer silhouette, User-defined boundary, or Box of target geometry.

tips.title: Calculate minimum tool length
tips.body: Check the Calculate Minimum Tool Length box to avoid holder gouging.

tips.title: Set holder clearance
tips.body: Define how close the tool holder can approach the material during machining.

tips.title: Use Force Change Tool for additional commands
tips.body: Check the Force Change Tool box to add tool change commands in GCode.

tips.title: Edit tool parameters or select a new tool
tips.body: Use the Select button to edit existing tool parameters or choose another tool from the TOOLKIT table.

tips.title: Define spin and feed rates
tips.body: Edit the Spin and Feed Rate Definition tab to set parameters for cutting, link down, link up, and rapid moves.

tips.title: Set spin direction
tips.body: Choose between clockwise (CW) or counterclockwise (CCW) for tool rotation.

tips.title: Define cutting conditions
tips.body: Update the cutting conditions for the current tool on the chosen CNC-machine.

tips.title: Define drive boundaries for Morphed machining
tips.body: Select existing geometries or create new ones for the first and second drive curves.

tips.title: Ensure drive curves have the same direction
tips.body: Make sure both drive curve directions are the same for correct machining.

tips.title: Specify direction of virtual offset from Drive curve
tips.body: Right, Left, or Both directions

tips.title: Determine machining direction along Drive curve
tips.body: Along or Across options

tips.title: Define tool path relation to boundary
tips.body: Internal, External, Centered, Boundary options

tips.title: Use Tangent option for boundary machining
tips.body: Avoids unmachined areas and corners rounding by projecting tool path boundaries on 3D model

tips.title: Specify offset value for tool center
tips.body: Positive values enlarge boundary, negative values reduce it

tips.title: Create auto-created box of target geometry boundary
tips.body: Automatically generates a rectangular box surrounding the target model

tips.title: Create auto-created box of stock geometry boundary
tips.body: Automatically generates a rectangular box surrounding the stock model

tips.title: Create auto-created silhouette boundary
tips.body: Automatically generates a silhouette boundary of the target model

tips.title: Create auto-created outer silhouette boundary
tips.body: Automatically generates an outer silhouette boundary of the target model

tips.title: Create boundary box manually
tips.body: Rectangular box surrounding selected model geometry

tips.title: Create silhouette boundary manually
tips.body: Projection of face edges onto XY-plane

tips.title: Create user-defined boundary manually
tips.body: Based on Working area geometry (closed loop of model edges as well as sketch entities)

tips.title: Create combined boundary using boolean operations
tips.body: Performing number of boolean operations between working area geometries and boundaries

tips.title: Define boundaries for HSM operations
tips.body: Use the Select Chain dialog box to choose chains based on boundary type, such as closed profile geometries or open profiles.

tips.title: Set Z-axis machining range
tips.body: Define upper and lower limits in the Limits section to set the machining range along the Z-axis.

tips.title: Adjust contact angle range
tips.body: Set the minimum and maximum contact angle in the Limits section to define the tool's contact angle range.

tips.title: Create boundaries from selected faces
tips.body: Use the Selected faces option to define boundaries by selecting drive and check faces similar to Working area definition for 3D Milling operations.

tips.title: Define shallow areas boundaries
tips.body: Use the Shallow Areas option to automatically determine shallow areas in the model and define boundaries around them.

tips.title: Create theoretical rest areas boundaries
tips.body: Use the Theoretical Rest Areas option to create 3D boundaries from rest areas left by an imaginary reference tool.

tips.title: Specify tool for theoretical rest areas
tips.body: Define the size of the tool by inserting values into the Tool diameter and Corner radius fields in the Reference Tool section.

tips.title: Create tool contact area boundaries
tips.body: Use the Tool Contact Areas option to create 3D boundaries around areas where the tool is in contact with the selected surface or surfaces.

tips.title: Adjust overthickness for tool contact areas
tips.body: Use the Overthickness option to apply an extra offset to the tool when calculating with a slightly larger tool to create smooth filleted edges.

tips.title: Limit tool motion in boundary calculation
tips.body: Use the Constrain option to limit the tool motion by center point or contact point within the boundary.

tips.title: Define rest areas for 3D boundaries
tips.body: Use the Select faces dialog box to choose model faces, then define parameters in the Rest Areas dialog box.

tips.title: Set minimum material depth for rest area calculation
tips.body: The Min. material depth value defines the granularity of the calculation, with a smaller value resulting in more detailed boundaries but slower calculations.

tips.title: Modify tool diameter with wall offset
tips.body: Positive values move the tool away from the machining surface, zero for finishing operations, and negative values penetrate the material.

tips.title: Adjust tool path tolerance for accuracy
tips.body: The Cut Tolerance parameter defines the maximum deviation from the surface, with smaller values providing more accurate paths.

tips.title: Set step down for pass spacing
tips.body: The Step down parameter defines the spacing of passes along the tool axis, regardless of XY-value unless Adaptive step down is selected.

tips.title: Define step over for pass separation
tips.body: Step over is the distance between two adjacent passes, varying in Morphed machining and Offset cutting strategies.

tips.title: Extend tool path with pass extension
tips.body: The Pass extension parameter allows extending the tool path beyond the boundary for better machining feed.

tips.title: Set minimum and maximum offsets for concentric profiles
tips.body: The Min. Offset and Max. Offset values define the range of space between passes, with constraints on their values.

tips.title: Insert tool path levels on flat areas
tips.body: The Detect Flat Areas option inserts a tool path level on flat areas and adjusts stepdowns to match these areas.

tips.title: Set Z-limits for tool movement
tips.body: The Z-Bottom and Z-Top limits define the range of Z-positions for tool movement, with options to limit by target or stock.

tips.title: Limit surface angles for machining
tips.body: The Angle parameter limits the work area to surface angles between specified values, useful for Constant Z strategy.

tips.title: Optimize tool path with point reduction
tips.body: The Fit arcs option activates arc fitting to the machining passes according to a specified tolerance value.

tips.title: Adjust tolerance within InventorCAM Settings
tips.body: Set tolerance in Defaults > Tolerance on the 3D HSM page.

tips.title: Refine corners for smoother tool path
tips.body: Enable Refine corners when Horizontal machining is selected.

tips.title: Enable tool path smoothing
tips.body: Check the Smoothing box to round tool path corners.

tips.title: Set maximum ramp angle for helical machining
tips.body: Define Max ramp angle to control descent angle of helix.

tips.title: Select climb milling for helical passes
tips.body: Enable Climb milling to perform helical machining in a climb direction.

tips.title: Detect core areas for outside-in machining
tips.body: Enable Detect core areas to start machining from the model's outside.

tips.title: Adjust Z-Top level for top-level passes
tips.body: Add Step down value to current Z-Top level to include top-level passes.

tips.title: Control scallop distance with cusp height
tips.body: Enable Scallop to adjust tool path line distance based on desired cusp height.

tips.title: Extend passes tangentially to model faces
tips.body: Enable Tangential extension to extend passes along model faces.

tips.title: Define hatch passes angle relative to X-axis
tips.body: Set Define angle by to specify the angle of hatch passes relative to the current Coordinate System.

tips.title: Set step over for radial patterns
tips.body: Define Step over to control spacing between passes along the circumference of a circle.

tips.title: Define center point for radial passes
tips.body: Specify XY-position of the center point when defining a radial pattern.

tips.title: Define angles for pattern passes
tips.body: Set minimum and maximum angles to define the start and end of pattern passes.

tips.title: Set direction of spiral tool path
tips.body: Enable Clockwise to define the direction of the spiral tool path.

tips.title: Define clear offset distances
tips.body: Set Left/right clear offset to define the distance used for virtual offset curve calculation.

tips.title: Set bitengency angle for Rest machining
tips.body: Define Bitengency angle to specify the minimum angle required between tool and model faces.

tips.title: Set steep threshold for area classification
tips.body: Define Steep threshold to specify the angle at which areas are split into shallow and steep.

tips.title: Enable extension in steep areas
tips.body: Select Extend steep areas to extend tool path in steep areas.

tips.title: Choose machining strategy for shallow areas
tips.body: Set Shallow areas strategy to choose the machining method for shallow areas.

tips.title: Set minimum and maximum depth of cut
tips.body: Define Min. depth of cut and Max. depth of cut to specify material removal limits.

tips.title: Select machining areas based on steep threshold
tips.body: Set Areas to choose whether to machine in steep, shallow, or both areas.

tips.title: Control stroke ordering for rest machining
tips.body: Set Stroke ordering to control how passes are merged for better rest machining.

tips.title: Set maximum deviation for pass continuity
tips.body: Define Max. deviation to control whether passes are continuous or split at sharp angles.

tips.title: Define reference tool diameter and corner radius
tips.body:
Diameter: Define the diameter of the reference tool.
Corner: Defined as half of the reference tool diameter.

tips.title: Enable variable stepover for better surface finish
tips.body: Variable stepover adapts the stepover distance to counteract stretching due to large surface inclination.

tips.title: Set horizontal and vertical step over distances
tips.body:
Horizontal step over: Distance between passes when offset horizontally.
Vertical step over: Distance between passes when offset vertically.

tips.title: Limit the number of offsets for drive boundary profiles
tips.body: Set a limit on the number of offsets to control the number of passes.

tips.title: Use adaptive variable side step for 2D offset only
tips.body: Step over will be taken from the horizontal plane only, using a 2D offset.

tips.title: Define extra thickness for tool path generation
tips.body: Set an overthickness value to generate a tool path along fillets with larger radii than the tool radius.

tips.title: Set offset type between adjacent Constant Z passes
tips.body: Choose Upper, Lower, or Both to define the offset and trimming of adjacent passes.

tips.title: Edit parameters on Constant Z passes page for Horizontal strategy
tips.body: Changes made on the Constant Z passes page are automatically applied to the Horizontal passes page.

tips.title: Edit parameters on Constant Z passes page for Linear strategy
tips.body: Changes made on the Constant Z passes page are automatically applied to the Linear passes page.

tips.title: Edit parameters on Constant Z passes page for 3D Constant Step over strategy
tips.body: Changes made on the Constant Z passes page are automatically applied to the Constant Step over passes page.

tips.title: Edit parameters on Constant Z passes page for 3D Corner offset strategy
tips.body: Changes made on the Constant Z passes page are automatically applied to the Corner Offset passes page.

tips.title: Define machining order for Constant Z and Horizontal passes
tips.body: Set the order of Constant Z and Horizontal machining on the Machining order tab.

tips.title: Define machining order for Constant Z and Linear passes
tips.body: Set the order of Constant Z and Linear machining on the Machining order tab.

tips.title: Define machining order for Constant Z and Constant step over passes
tips.body: Set the order of Constant Z and Constant step over machining on the Machining order tab.

tips.title: Define machining order for Constant Z and Corner offset passes
tips.body: Set the order of Constant Z and Corner offset machining on the Machining order tab.

tips.title: Adjust calculation speed based on tool type and tolerance
tips.body: Calculation speed may differ for different tool types and tolerances.

tips.title: Enable tool path smoothing to round corners
tips.body: Tool path smoothing rounds the corners of the tool path, reducing wear and allowing higher feed rates.

tips.title: Set maximum arc radius for smoothing
tips.body: Define the maximum arc radius allowed during tool path smoothing.

tips.title: Set offset tolerance for smoothed profiles
tips.body: Maximum distance between smoothed profile and sharp corner of imaginary profile at same offset.

tips.title: Use adaptive step down for precise machining
tips.body: Inserts extra passes to reduce horizontal distance between passes and compensate for edge proximity.

tips.title: Adjust profile step-in for accurate Z-level insertion
tips.body: Controls maximal XY-distance between cutting profiles on successive Z-levels.

tips.title: Define scallop for cusp control
tips.body: Cusp defined by combination of Min. step down and Scallop parameters; must be positive and smaller than Min. step down.

tips.title: Edit passes parameters for stock trimming
tips.body: Allows manual editing and insertion of passes to avoid unnecessary air cutting.

tips.title: Use drive curve for consistent step down
tips.body: Determines heights at which passes are calculated using a drive curve, maintaining consistency in shallow areas.

tips.title: Define overthickness for tool path trimming
tips.body: Extra thickness applied to tool, can be negative or positive, affecting pass selection.

tips.title: Set axial overthickness for cutter lift/drop
tips.body: Applies value to cutter, lifting or dropping along tool axis, affecting horizontal surfaces.

tips.title: Define pass extension for tool path trimming
tips.body: Length of pass extension, allowing cutter to move into cut at Machining Feed rate.

tips.title: Select stock definition style for machining area
tips.body: Options include Target geometry, Auto updated stock, Stock by FCT file, and Stock by STL file.

tips.title: Enable gouge check while linking tool paths
tips.body: Automatically detects and avoids collisions between tool and surfaces during tool path linking.

tips.title: Define axial offset for tool path generation
tips.body: Generates tool paths in positive Z-direction, enabling semi-finish and finish machining in vertical steps.

tips.title: Set cross linear machining order
tips.body: Determines the order of performing Linear and Cross linear machining.

tips.title: Link tool paths with general parameters
tips.body: Defines the way generated passes are linked together into a tool path, including ramping and retractions.

tips.title: Define direction of machining
tips.body: One way: Machining in one direction, no guarantee of climb or conventional milling; Reverse: Direction of passes reversed; Bi-directional: Each pass in opposite direction with zigzag motion.

tips.title: Set down/up mill direction
tips.body: Down mill: Machining downwards; Up mill: Machining upwards.

tips.title: Prefer climb milling
tips.body: Select to perform pencil milling passes as climb milled or conventional milled based on material position.

tips.title: Define direction for steep regions
tips.body: Choose climb milling, conventional milling, or bi-directional for steep areas.

tips.title: Order passes
tips.body: Default order: Efficient linking to minimize rapid travel; Reverse order: Order of creation, increasing air movements.

tips.title: Link by Z-level
tips.body: Perform all passes at a specific Z-level before moving to the next, increasing air movements between areas.

tips.title: Link per cluster
tips.body: Machine each corner before moving to another, avoiding rapid feed rate moves.

tips.title: Use dynamic stock
tips.body: Enable use of dynamic stock slices for better tool path accuracy, slower but more optimal.

tips.title: Set minimum profile size
tips.body: Define the smallest diameter of a profile to avoid difficulties in ramping the tool.

tips.title: Set minimum pass length
tips.body: Define the minimal length of a pass to avoid machining extremely short passes.

tips.title: Set maximum stock thickness
tips.body: Control the order of Constant Z machining for several cutting areas.

tips.title: Control cutting levels based on stock thickness
tips.body: When distance between cutting areas < Max. stock thickness, machine at specific level; when > Max. stock thickness, machine each area at all levels.

tips.title: Ramping parameters for tool path control
tips.body: Adjust ramp height offset, angle, and max. ramp angle to control tool movement between levels.

tips.title: Define relative or absolute ramp height
tips.body: Choose between relative (offset from first point) or absolute (measured from origin) for ramp start position.

tips.title: Avoid machining short profiles with Min. profile diameter
tips.body: Set a minimum profile diameter to prevent ramping on small features.

tips.title: Control link movement between passes
tips.body: Use Stay on surface within, Stay down within, and Along surface options to control tool movement.

tips.title: Overlap closed passes for island machining
tips.body: Enable Overlap closed passes to avoid material left between closed passes.

tips.title: Smooth transitions between passes
tips.body: Use Straight line, Spline curve, or Tangential Ramp options for smooth transitions.

tips.title: Generate helical style finish with Trim to ramp advance
tips.body: Select Trim to ramp advance to generate a helical style tool path when linking Constant Z passes.

tips.title: Control linking radius for S-shaped curves
tips.body: Set Linking radius to define the radius of S-shaped curves linking adjacent closed passes.

tips.title: Maintain horizontal clearance with Link clearance
tips.body: Set Link clearance to maintain minimal distance from the bounding profile during horizontal movements.

tips.title: Define retract styles between passes
tips.body: Choose from Shortest route, Minimal vertical retract, or Custom style for retract movements.

tips.title: Full vertical retract
tips.body: Tool moves vertically up to the clearance plane, then rapidly in a straight line and drops back down.

tips.title: Clearance parameters
tips.body: Parameters include 'Clear surface within', 'Minimum rapid length', and 'Clear surface by'.

tips.title: Smoothing radius for retract motions
tips.body: InventorCAM rounds sharp corners of retract motions using a vertical curve with a defined radius.

tips.title: Curls for lead-in and lead-out movements
tips.body: Arcs are added at the end of lead-in and start of lead-out movements to define radii.

tips.title: Stay on surface within parameter
tips.body: Defines the maximum distance between passes to stay on the surface before performing a retract movement.

tips.title: Fitting options for retract movements
tips.body: Options include 'Machine the whole pass', 'Lead in/Lead out arc', and 'Arc can be applied at the end of the pass'.

tips.title: Minimize trimming option
tips.body: Performs the arc retract movement with minimal possible trimming of the cutting tool pass.

tips.title: Max trimming distance parameter
tips.body: Limits the trimming distance to prevent large unmachined areas.

tips.title: Vertical leads parameters
tips.body: Defines the radius of arcs located in a vertical plane used to enter and leave the machining pass.

tips.title: Horizontal leads parameters
tips.body: Defines the radius of arcs located in a horizontal plane used to enter and leave the machining pass.

tips.title: Max ramp angle parameter
tips.body: Limits the maximum angle for ramping during arc lead-in.

tips.title: Ramp height offset parameter
tips.body: Extra height used in the ramping motion down from a top profile.

tips.title: Lead out angle parameter
tips.body: Defines the angle of inclined lead-out movement.

tips.title: Basic horizontal approaches check box
tips.body: Enables separate lead-in/lead-out movements for each Z-level pass in Constant Z machining.

tips.title: Pass overlap parameter
tips.body: Extends pass segments to ensure a smoother finish.

tips.title: Shallow angle parameter
tips.body: Defines model areas with inclination angles less than the value for machining in either direction.

tips.title: Merge % parameter
tips.body: Limits the length of opposite segments as a relative percentage of the whole pass.

tips.title: Remove Spikes option
tips.body: Removes sharp jumps from the tool path.

tips.title: Non-spike allowance parameter
tips.body: Trims off any small horizontal areas left at the top or bottom of spikes.

tips.title: Enable 4th Axis projection
tips.body: Select Indexial for rotational angle extension or Face Sim for linear to rotary conversion.

tips.title: Configure GCode output coordinates
tips.body: Choose between XYZ (Diameter) for 3-axis machines or Face for 3-axis Mill-Turn CNCs.

tips.title: Set Coordinate type for GCode
tips.body: Select Polar for polar coordinates or Cartesian for linear movements.

tips.title: Choose appropriate plane for toolpath generation
tips.body: Select XC, YC, or ZC based on the machine's capabilities.

tips.title: Approximate arcs by lines in GCode
tips.body: Enable the Approximate arcs by lines check box to control arc existence in GCode output.

tips.title: Control arc approximation precision
tips.body: Adjust Max Chord Length and Max Arc Angle parameters on the Controller Definition page.

tips.title: Enable point interpolation for linear motions
tips.body: Use the Interpolation for distance option to create intermediate points during linear movements.

tips.title: Convert rapid motions to feed motions
tips.body: Activate the Rapid feed rate moves option to convert all rapid motions into feed motions.

tips.title: Edit HSR/HSM tool path using Boundaries and Z-levels
tips.body: Select Boundaries, Z-levels, or Boundaries & Z-levels to define the editing strategy.

tips.title: Trim tool path using Boundaries
tips.body: Enable the Keep tool path outside the Boundary check box to trim passes inside the boundary.

tips.title: Define boundaries and Z-levels for tool path editing
tips.body: Set Boundary Type, Boundary name, Boundary offset, and Z-levels on the Boundaries and Z-levels page.
